brief.t: START HERE: Verify payment for container EMCU8614105 and forward the receipt to Erik now so release can proceed.

Send: Michael, I am closing the 100 kg Agua decision now and will send you the approval status and current ETA for Silgreen G, Cheriosa 62, and Magnolia today.

ACT NOW 3: Armenak Shahbazian is waiting on the Buffman shipment, whose October 4 ETA is now 17 calendar days late with no verified delivery update. Send: Armenak, please confirm the shipment's current location, release status, carrier, tracking, and firm delivery date today.
